body.text: Reference template: copy the repo, reuse a part, or reimplement the architecture. This is the sample pass. Send a plate with the form, then press the four airlock buttons. Drop a new card in modules/cards. Kinds are a closed set, and unknown fields are refused. The airlock's hull check beats the allowlist, so a metadata address stays denied even if a policy file names it. A permit is held in the dry dock. Nothing is sent.
